# Ping Pong & Table Tennis Log (TT Tracker)

> Free table tennis training journal for iPhone, iPad and Android. Log practice sessions in under 30 seconds, record matches game by game against saved opponents, and see progress with a 12-month training heatmap and win-rate stats. No account, works offline, available in 22 languages. Free to use; an optional one-time purchase, TT Tracker Pro, adds training insights (streaks, training load, session-type mix), head-to-head records, 6-month/1-year/all-time charts, streak and training-load widgets, CSV export and accent colors (price shown in each store). This site also hosts a free table tennis serve encyclopedia, an equipment encyclopedia (blades, rubbers, pro player setups) and printable training plans.

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6758044383
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=xyz.tleskiv.tt
- Languages: English at the root; other languages under /es, /de, /fr, /pt, /ja, /zh, /zh-tw, /ko, /it, /uk, /tr, /id, /hi, /ar

## App

- [Home](https://ttapp.smashyapps.com/): features, screenshots, Free vs Pro and FAQ for the app

## Serve encyclopedia

- [All serves](https://ttapp.smashyapps.com/serves): 29 table tennis serves with spin, bounce, placement, contact point and how to return each one
- [Serve motions](https://ttapp.smashyapps.com/motions): pendulum, reverse pendulum, tomahawk, backhand, hook, chop and other serve motions
- [Spin types](https://ttapp.smashyapps.com/spins): backspin, topspin, sidespin, no-spin and corkscrew explained
- [Serve rules](https://ttapp.smashyapps.com/rules): ITTF legal serve rules, common faults and FAQ
- [Serve quiz](https://ttapp.smashyapps.com/quiz): test your serve-reading knowledge

## Equipment encyclopedia (English only)

Specs come from each maker's published data with sources on every page; unknown values are shown as unknown. Manufacturer speed/spin ratings are on each brand's own scale and sponge hardness on the scale the maker prints (European/ESN, Japanese or Chinese), so neither is compared across brands.

- [Equipment overview](https://ttapp.smashyapps.com/equipment): blades, rubbers, brands and guides
- [Blades](https://ttapp.smashyapps.com/equipment/blades): table tennis blades with plies, carbon type and position (inner/outer), thickness, weight and handles
- [Rubbers](https://ttapp.smashyapps.com/equipment/rubbers): tensor, Chinese tacky, hybrid, short, medium and long pips rubbers with sponge hardness and thicknesses
- [Compare](https://ttapp.smashyapps.com/equipment/compare): up to four blades or rubbers side by side
- [Pro setups](https://ttapp.smashyapps.com/equipment/pros): blades and rubbers of the top-ranked men and women, with sources and dates, updated weekly
- [Guides](https://ttapp.smashyapps.com/equipment/guides): carbon and fibres (ALC, ZLC), inner vs outer carbon, plies and woods, handles, rubber types, pips, sponge hardness scales, sponge thickness, speed glue and boosting
- [Glossary](https://ttapp.smashyapps.com/equipment/glossary): equipment terms explained
